We propose a substantial class recovery, with fees separate from the fund and subject to the court’s independent review.

Whitcombe Reyes’s latest term sheet has the lowest total stated outlay at $34 million, within authorization, and provides automatic distribution with no clear-sailing commitment. Accepting it resolves the overlapping litigation; the other proposals are either more expensive or exceed the authorized cap.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fees alongside class relief before either was settled, and Whitcombe Reyes later proposed shifting more of the same total outlay to the class. Defense chose Whitcombe Reyes’s proposal because it was the cheapest way to resolve the overlapping litigation. The record does not show counsel sacrificing class relief for its own compensation or a misleading court declaration.
